{{Aquarius}}

Aquarius is the 3rd month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 9–12.

== Overview ==
Life on Land develops
===Etymology===
English ''Aquarius'' "water-bearer" (Latin). Japanese: {{ill|水瓶座|ja|Mizugame-za}} “water-jar constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 9–12 (Days [[Aquarius 1]]–[[Aquarius 28]]): late **Devonian** transitions, early **Carboniferous** dawn, land vertebrate adaptations, and continental eco-shifts.  
===EVENTS===
* [[Aquarius 7]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Hinamatsuri_falls_on|Hinamatsuri]]  
* [[Aquarius 21]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Kōrei-sai_(皇霊祭)_falls_on|Kōrei-sai]], Ides of March, St Patricks day  
* [[Aquarius 28]] — Easter Sunday
